purpose: Per-archetype (domain) correctness of the whole governed decision — the single actionable top action, the four-dimension coverage (consulting stage, business condition, intervention mode/phase, human execution reality), and the safety boundary each domain must hold. Proven by the DB simulation (10 tests, LANE_B).

domains.topAction: fix the failing process step with proof (CREATE_CORRECTION_TASK)
domains.businessCondition: quality/rework loop, margin at risk from discount temptation
domains.humanExecutionReality: manager executes correction; owner owns the pricing decision
domains.safetyBoundary: no auto customer contact/apology, no auto refund/discount, no blaming named staff

domains.topAction: inspect + prove the missed-area fix (CREATE_CORRECTION_TASK), then SOP/train
domains.businessCondition: process-quality breakdown, high turnover, contract SLA risk
domains.humanExecutionReality: manager inspection; training adoption proof required; reputation/contract held for owner
domains.safetyBoundary: no auto client outreach, no auto discount, no staff-discipline automation

domains.businessCondition: operational bottleneck, vacancy opportunity, high owner workload
domains.humanExecutionReality: manager vendor follow-up; owner owns high spend/legal/reputation; owner-workload risk flagged
domains.safetyBoundary: no auto tenant messaging/send, no auto legal/rent action, no auto vendor spend

domains.businessCondition: cross-branch inconsistency, unauthorized local promo, brand/pricing risk
domains.humanExecutionReality: manager/franchisee follow-up; owner owns brand/pricing/franchisee consequences
domains.safetyBoundary: no franchisee-penalty automation, no auto public response, no auto pricing enforcement

domains.topAction: reproduce the bug before claiming fixed (CREATE_EVIDENCE_REQUEST)
domains.businessCondition: product-support issue, activation opportunity, launch readiness gaps
domains.interventionMode: evidence-first bug proof; activation/pricing as a data gap
domains.humanExecutionReality: OpsIQ drafts the proof request; owner owns pricing + any launch decision
domains.safetyBoundary: no fabricated MRR/conversion/ROI, no public launch while readiness gaps remain, no auto pricing change

domains.topAction: collect eligibility/cost/EMD data (CREATE_MISSING_DATA_TASK); owner decides bid/no-bid
domains.businessCondition: opportunity signal (VERIFIED_SOURCE, STRONG) but internal fit unknown, compliance/contract risk HIGH
domains.interventionMode: readiness/eligibility data collection; bid decision escalated
domains.humanExecutionReality: staff/owner supply eligibility + cost; owner owns the bid/EMD commitment
domains.safetyBoundary: no tender auto-submit, no auto EMD payment/spend, no auto contract signing

domains.businessCondition: opportunity signal, capability gap HIGH, internal capacity unknown
domains.interventionMode: fit validation data gap; outreach escalated
domains.humanExecutionReality: staff supply capacity/cost proof; owner owns outreach + pursuit commitment
domains.safetyBoundary: no auto outreach/send, no fabricated win probability/revenue, no auto commitment

domains.topAction: fix quality first (CREATE_CORRECTION_TASK) — the CRITICAL actionable top, NOT scale
domains.businessCondition: multi-module conflict: scale temptation vs unresolved quality, missing cost/capacity, weak staffing, high owner workload
domains.interventionMode: quality correction + cost/capacity data gap; scale decision escalated & blocked-before-proof
domains.humanExecutionReality: manager fixes quality; owner owns any scale/spend; owner-workload + key-person risk flagged
domains.safetyBoundary: no scale before validation, no spend before cost data, no growth while quality unresolved
provenBy: test 9 (top=pc:quality CREATE_CORRECTION_TASK, scale owner-gated, costdata=data task)

summary.note: Every domain yields exactly one actionable top action with the rest collapsed behind it, models all four OpsIQ dimensions, and holds its archetype-specific safety boundary.
